article.title: The whip-banning polity that is Reno
article.excerpt: The Reno City Council voted to ban the possession and use of whips without a permit in downtown Reno on Wednesday. Councilwoman Jenny Brekhus, who said she was not present when the ordinance was introduced, was the only no vote. Brekhus said that she wants the ordinance applied city-wide and expressed concern that as is, the ban targets certain demographics.
